data.explanation: die Messe, Plural: die Messen. A large exhibition, particularly for industry, trade, or business. From Latin 'missa' (dismissal/mass), historically linked to markets held on church festival days.
data.example_de: Wir besuchen nächste Woche die Frankfurter Buchmesse.
data.example_translated: We are visiting the Frankfurt Book Fair next week.

data.explanation: der Durchbruch, Plural: die Durchbrüche. Derived from 'durchbrechen' (to break through). Means a sudden, major advance or success in a specific field.
data.example_de: Dem Forschungsteam gelang ein medizinischer Durchbruch.
data.example_translated: The research team achieved a medical breakthrough.

translations.French: argument clé de vente / caractéristique unique

data.explanation: das Alleinstellungsmerkmal, Plural: die Alleinstellungsmerkmale. A compound business term: allein (alone) + Stellung (position) + Merkmal (feature). The distinct feature that makes a product stand out from competitors.
data.example_de: Gute Qualität allein ist heute kein Alleinstellungsmerkmal mehr.
data.example_translated: Good quality alone is no longer a unique selling proposition today.

data.explanation: verhandeln (weak verb, regular, inseparable prefix 'ver-'). Requires 'mit' + Dativ (negotiate with someone) or 'über' + Akkusativ (negotiate about something). Frequently used in corporate and political environments.
data.example_de: Die Gewerkschaft verhandelt mit den Arbeitgebern über höhere Löhne.
data.example_translated: The union is negotiating with employers for higher wages.

data.explanation: die Dienstleistung, Plural: die Dienstleistungen. Compound word: Dienst (service/duty) + Leistung (performance/output). Refers to intangible economic activities offered to customers.
data.example_de: Unser Unternehmen bietet IT-Dienstleistungen für Kleinbetriebe an.
data.example_translated: Our company offers IT services for small businesses.

data.explanation: der Umsatz, Plural: die Umsätze. Derived from 'umsetzen' (to turn over/convert). Total volume of sales made by a business within a specific timeframe before deducting expenses.
data.example_de: Der Umsatz stieg im vergangenen Quartal um zehn Prozent.
data.example_translated: Turnover increased by ten percent in the past quarter.

data.explanation: wettbewerbsfähig, comparative: wettbewerbsfähiger. From Wettbewerb (competition) + fähig (capable). Describes a firm or product capable of competing successfully in global or domestic sectors.
data.example_de: Um wettbewerbsfähig zu bleiben, müssen wir die Kosten senken.
data.example_translated: To remain competitive, we must reduce costs.

data.explanation: die Zielgruppe, Plural: die Zielgruppen. Compound: Ziel (goal/target) + Gruppe (group). A specific consumer profile or demographic category at which marketing campaigns are aimed.
data.example_de: Jugendliche zwischen 14 und 18 Jahren sind unsere primäre Zielgruppe.
data.example_translated: Youths between 14 and 18 years old are our primary target group.
